_comment: Triaged, accepted-pending-upgrade advisories. All are framework-transitive (next / nodemailer / undici, via Payload + Next 15.3.9). Remediation: upgrade Next.js to the latest patched 15.x and Payload accordingly, then re-run scripts/audit-ci.mjs to re-baseline. Tracked in docs/SECURITY.md. Any high/critical advisory NOT listed here fails CI.
